@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: 'Guided MTP: hand over a finalized drafter continuation so the next turn''s drafter starts warm'
+---
+## What
+Since ^nztjxdh a guided pass checks its ledger into the prompt cache, but `ExecutorGuidedHandOff.commit` checks in no MTP drafter continuation: `GuidedSpeculation` keeps an `MTPDrafterState` with an entry for the pending token and never finalizes it (the plain path does this in `MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator` via `finalizeDrafterState`). The next turn after a guided turn therefore cold-starts its drafter where the cache ends — output is unchanged, acceptance on the first rounds is lower.
+
+## Fix
+- At the end of a local guided speculative generation, finalize the drafter state at the main cache position (`ResumableMTPDrafterModel.finalizeDrafterState`) and hand it over through `GuidedCacheHandOff`; commit it with the entry (`commitOutcome` keeps it only when aligned with the ledger).
+- A prompt-end checkpoint of a guided pass can keep the drafter continuation of the prefill feed too.
+
+## Tests
+- After a speculative guided turn, the entry's drafterState is aligned with the ledger, and the next speculative turn resumes it (no cold start) with output equal to a cold turn.
\ No newline at end of file

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m8gn44mkgcw92b82vtwmarq3
+  text: |-
+    Research:
+    - GuidedSpeculation keeps the drafter in "pending form" after commitDrafter (entry for the next token at main-1). Most guided generations end WITHOUT a commit: `speculate` returns nil after `keepVerified` when `decoder.accept(draft)` stops or `decide` returns nil (stop/budget), and `feedForcedTokens` likewise. So finalize must first append the kept tail (remove the proposal entries, append fed[1..<kept] paired with verify hidden[0..<kept-1], boundary = hidden[kept-1]); that is already the finalized form. When the generation ends after a commit (stopsBeforeDeciding / budget loop exit), `finalizeDrafterState(discarded: 0)` normalizes it. After a stand-down to plain decoding the main cache passes the drafter; finalize refuses and nothing is handed over.
+    - Qwen 3.5 MTP and Inkling 2 DSpark both use the default shifted-drafter finalize/commit; both are GuidedMTPDrafter (resumable).
+    - Cluster path: RemoteMTPDrafter is not Resumable and the plain cluster iterator hands over no continuation either; rank 0 keeps its own state per cache. Nothing needed there.
+    - Prompt-end checkpoint: at prefillDidEnd the prefill feed stands before the final segment. A copy of the feed extended over the final segment (as one more chunk) is the continuation at the prompt end (same as the plain path's primed-state-minus-bonus). Read lazily, only when the slot takes the checkpoint.
+    - Resume witness: `drafterState.state.cacheStartPosition == 0` (a cold start at a cached position starts there), as ExecutorPromptCacheMTPTests uses.
